contentBlocks.body: An interface names the shape of an object: which keys it has and the type of each value. Functions can then accept that interface and the compiler checks every property for you.

choices: the shape of an object: its keys and value types
payload.answer: the shape of an object: its keys and value types
payload.explanation: Interfaces define the expected properties and their types.

payload.text: In an interface, a property that holds text is annotated as name: ____.
